revenueModel.text: The Group earns net interest income from loans and advances to customers, plus fee and other banking income from retail, asset management and wholesale banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: Internationally diversified and with strengths in the traditional banking businesses of retail banking, asset management and wholesale banking, the Group is committed to offering a compelling digital proposition focused on customer experience.

changes.text: In 2025, the operating segment structure remained the same as in 2024, with only immaterial intra-group reallocations between segments and the Corporate Center.
changes.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the structure of the operating segments used by the BBVA Group for management purposes remained the same as in 2024.
